Category: Announcements
Title:    📖 Guide: Credits explained: what's free, what costs what, and refunds
-->

Rolebranch is free during the beta. Romy's work uses **credits**, and every job shows its cost
before it runs, so you always choose.

## How you get credits

- **100 welcome credits** when you join. They never expire.
- **50 more every month**, on the day you joined. Unused monthly credits don't roll over.
- A **coupon** can add more: [Redeem a coupon](https://rolebranch.com/help/credits/redeem-a-coupon).

## What Romy's work costs

| Job | Credits |
| --- | --- |
| A reply from Romy in chat | 1 |
| A tailored CV | 5 |
| A cover letter | 3 |
| Interview prep (questions built from the posting) | 10 |
| Feedback on one practice answer | 1 |

The in-app price list is the one that counts: see
[What a credit buys](https://rolebranch.com/help/credits/what-a-credit-buys).

## Always free

Importing a CV, reading a posting, the match, the CV score, editing your CVs and letters yourself,
the templates, tracking applications and downloading PDFs.

## If a run fails

You aren't charged. Romy sets the credits aside when a job starts and only takes them when it
finishes; if it fails or you cancel, they go back by themselves.
[More →](https://rolebranch.com/help/credits/refunds-when-a-run-fails)

## If you run out

Everything you made stays, and you can keep editing, tracking and exporting. Only Romy's work waits
until your next monthly credits arrive.
[More →](https://rolebranch.com/help/credits/when-credits-run-out)

A charge looks wrong? Don't post your account details here: send it through
[rolebranch.com/help/request](https://rolebranch.com/help/request) and say which job it was.
